entries.title: 视频脚本一鱼多吃
entries.summary: 把YouTube脚本或字幕改写成线程、LinkedIn、Shorts钩子、newsletter等渠道。
entries.prompt:
Take this YouTube video script/transcript and repurpose it into:
• A Twitter/X thread
• A LinkedIn post
• 3 YouTube Shorts hooks
• An email newsletter
• A Pinterest description

Also suggest which platforms to prioritize based on my niche.
entries.author: NextGenAi5

entries.title: 定价文案十秒读懂
entries.summary: 把定价说明改写到首次客户十秒内能看懂，减少困惑私信。
entries.prompt: Here's my pricing text: [paste]. Rewrite it so a first-time customer understands it in 10 seconds.
entries.author: maged_hampoop

entries.title: 难懂邮件十二岁解释
entries.summary: 把账单或工作邮件讲成人话，并给出对方要什么、截止与回复建议。
entries.prompt: Explain this like I'm 12. What do they want from me, by when, and what should I reply?
entries.author: DaDDyWaRBuXx1
